title: Juicy Crisp Vietnamese Tofu Bun Cha
description: A winey and crisp Vietnamese dish featuring oregano, perfect for a brunch mood, this ovo-vegetarian-friendly recipe is made with tofu and served in a bun cha form, grilled to perfection on a binchotan grill.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Prepare the binchotan grill by heating it to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, and vegetable oil to make the marinade.
Add the tofu cubes to the marinade and let it sit for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the marinade and pat it dry with paper towels.
Grill the tofu on the binchotan grill for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it is golden brown and crispy.
Shock the grilled tofu in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Cook the bun cha noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together chopped oregano, minced garlic, and grated ginger.
Assemble the dish by placing the grilled tofu on top of the noodles, and garnishing with the oregano mixture, pickled carrots, and sliced cucumber.
